results.title: Pixel 11 Pro launches with the best Gemini Intelligence, yet
results.content:
Each device has the same stated battery rating of 30 hours or more, which is up from the 24 hours Google claimed for the Pixel 10 Pro. The Pixel 11 Pro reaches that with a 4,850mAh battery, and the Pixel 11 Pro XL packs a 5,115mAh battery. It seems Google is hedging its bets on better performance with improved power efficiency from the Tensor G6, since the Pixel 10 Pro had a negligibly larger battery when it launched last year. Time will tell, but anything over a full day would be welcome.

At $1,099, the Pixel 11 Pro sees a price jump from the $999 Pixel 10 Pro, but that’s because the cheapest option is now a 256GB model, instead of 128GB. RAMaggeddon comes for us all, but the Pixel 11 series might begin to lose its grip on its affordability classification with the Pixel 11 Pro XL, which is more expensive, no matter how you look at it. It’s up from $1,119 to $1,299 this year. It will all boil down to whether Tensor G6 has the power to make for a smooth experience with good battery life and a dependable camera. The Gemini stuff is a bonus.

Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available starting today in Canyon, Olive, Fog, and in a void of Matte Obsidian colorways.

results.title: Exclusive: Google Pixel 11 Series Full Specs + US & EU ...
results.content:
## Google Pixel 11 Pro specs & price

The Google Pixel 11 Pro, on the other hand, will feature a 6.3-inch Super Actua OLED LTPO display. So it will be the same size as the one on the Pixel 11. The resolution will be 2856 x 1280, so higher, while this panel will also offer an adaptive refresh rate (1-120Hz). The brightness goes up to 3,600 nits, while the Gorilla Glass Victus 2 screen protection is also a part of the package.

#### The Pixel 11 Pro will offer up to 16GB of RAM

Google’s Tensor G6 chip will fuel the phone, along with the Titan M3 coprocessor, just like on the Pixel 11. That chip will be backed by 12GB and 16GB of RAM here, along with 256GB and 512GB of storage. A 4,850mAh battery (typical) will be included (4,707mAh minimum capacity). This phone will also support 30W wired USB-C PPS charging, along with Qi2 wireless charging.

...

The phone will support 5G, and will have an in-display fingerprint scanner along with facial scanning via the selfie camera. It will measure 152.7 x 71.9 x 8.4mm, and weigh 204 grams.

The Google Pixel 11 Pro’s pricing will start at $1,099 in the US and €1,199 in Europe.
